text: Hello, I'm so sorry to message at this time of night. I'm a childminder and I've got one of my little ones staying over as his parents are stuck abroad with a cancelled flight. Theo is 23 months old. I checked his temperature before bed because he felt a bit hot, and it was 38.8, and it's about the same now when I re-checked half an hour later. He's also got a few insect bites on his arms and one on his cheek that he keeps trying to scratch, they look itchy rather than anything else. I've spoken to his mum and she said he's had a temperature with colds before. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing as I'm responsible for him and I'd feel awful if I'd missed something. Is there anything I should give him or keep an eye on? Thank you, and apologies again for taking up your time.
